theme: 3 terms on building screens: the visual editor, the file for one view, and the code-only approach

terms.definition: The visual editor in Xcode where you drag and drop views to design a screen.
terms.example: Do the simple screens in Interface Builder, it takes a minute.

terms.definition: A file that stores the layout of one view or screen, loaded at runtime as a nib.
terms.example: Each cell has its own Xib, so the storyboard stays small.
terms.code:
let nib = UINib(nibName: "NoteCell",
    bundle: nil)
tableView.register(nib,
    forCellReuseIdentifier: "NoteCell")

terms.definition: Building your screens in Swift code instead of dragging views in a visual editor.
terms.example: We use Programmatic UI, so merge conflicts are easy to read.

video.title: Interface Builder, Xib & Programmatic UI | Day 99
video.description:
Learn to explain how teams build screens with and without a visual editor: Interface Builder, Xib & Programmatic UI, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Interface Builder - The visual editor in Xcode where you drag and drop views to design a screen.
Xib - A file that stores the layout of one view or screen, loaded at runtime as a nib.
Programmatic UI - Building your screens in Swift code instead of dragging views in a visual editor.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Interface Builder, Xib & Programmatic UI | Day 99
landscape.description:
Explain Interface Builder, Xib & Programmatic UI in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
인터페이스 빌더, Xib, 프로그래밍 방식 UI 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Interface Builder - The visual editor in Xcode where you drag and drop views to design a screen.
한국어: 인터페이스 빌더: 화면을 디자인하려고 뷰를 끌어다 놓는 Xcode의 시각적 편집기

Xib - A file that stores the layout of one view or screen, loaded at runtime as a nib.
한국어: Xib: 스토리보드 없이 뷰 하나나 화면 하나의 레이아웃을 저장하는 파일

Programmatic UI - Building your screens in Swift code instead of dragging views in a visual editor.
한국어: 프로그래밍 방식 UI: 시각적 편집기에서 뷰를 끌어다 놓는 대신 Swift 코드로 화면을 만드는 방식

In this video, Mina and Jake decide how to build the new screens, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Storyboard or code? Can you explain the choice in English?

dialogue.title: Storyboard or code?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, should we keep using Interface Builder for the new screens?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For small screens it's fast. For bigger ones I prefer Programmatic UI.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why? Interface Builder shows the layout directly.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Merge conflicts. A storyboard conflict is hard to read, Swift code isn't.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Give each cell its own Xib. Then you call `register` with the nib.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Like `NoteCell`? I see it in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The Xib keeps the cell layout, and the table loads it on demand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. So a Xib for cells, Programmatic UI for the main screens?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. Use Interface Builder only when the team agrees.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'll bring it up at stand-up.

dialogue.code:
let nib = UINib(nibName: "NoteCell",
    bundle: nil)
tableView.register(nib,
    forCellReuseIdentifier: "NoteCell")

lines.text: Drag, drop, connect. That's Interface Builder.
